method.lighthouse: 12.8.2 mobile defaults, median of 3 per metric
method.after: Cloudflare production build, Vite preview port 7846 through gzip-only HTTP proxy port 7847
method.compressionLimit: Live Cloudflare Brotli and local gzip, network distance and edge caching differ. The gzip proxy buffers responses. Uncompressed preview was measured separately at 56/56, LCP 11.34/11.79s on an intermediate candidate; not the sealed head.
method.inpProxy: Playwright Chromium CDP CPU rate 4; worst event timing while opening Products/Resources, toggling theme/language and scrolling; desktop 1440x844. Not field INP.
method.screenshots: 16 viewport PNGs: EN/VI x light/dark x 390x844/1440x1000; before live, after local production build.
method.emptyEventSample: A null proxy with a complete action log means no EventTiming entries at or above the 16 ms observer threshold; report <16 ms, not zero.
method.retry: One Vietnamese Lighthouse gather failed with Target.closeTarget: No target with given id found. Completed EN and VI samples were retained; only missing VI samples were resumed with identical options.
